revisions.observation: inspect_env.py execution in prior wake showed CWD is memory/core_workspace/tools and core files exist at memory/.
revisions.claim: Environment verification tools can reliably find core memory files by traversing parent directories from CWD until required files are found.
revisions.prediction: A script searching upward from os.getcwd() will locate memory/ and verify identity.md, rules.md, and index.md.
revisions.test: Wrote updated verify_environment.py with parent directory traversal and executed via tool-run.
revisions.outcome: Tool executed and stdout confirmed memory root discovery.
revisions.revision: Root environment tools must use dynamic parent traversal rather than relative CWD assumptions.
